tool.description: Report current branch, KB snapshot, freshness metadata, schema status, and a typed kibi.migration-plan.v2 action graph. Call it first to orient on a branch or after a failed call; use kb_check for validation findings and kb_coverage for proof status. Read-only status inspection with no mutation side effects; damaged stores are diagnosed without starting the engine.

kb.description: Optional KB dependency name from .kb/dependencies.json to read, at its pinned commit, instead of this project's KB.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional absolute path of the workspace this call is about, such as your git worktree, when it is not the server's.

tool.name: kb_status
